request.query: upper estimate sum x plus square root x plus square root delta bounded by iterated half power delta

items.name: Finset.le_sum_schlomilch
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : ℕ → M} {u : ℕ → ℕ},
  (∀ ⦃m n : ℕ⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < u n) →
      Monotone u →
        ∀ (n : ℕ),
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (u n), f k ≤
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (u 0), f k + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (u (k + 1) - u k) • f (u k)

items.name: Nat.sqrt_le_add
items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ), n ≤ n.sqrt * n.sqrt + n.sqrt + n.sqrt

items.name: Nat.sqrt.iter_sq_le
items.type: ∀ (n guess : ℕ), Nat.sqrt.iter n guess * Nat.sqrt.iter n guess ≤ n

items.name: ENNReal.le_tsum_schlomilch
items.type:
∀ {u : ℕ → ℕ} {f : ℕ → ENNReal},
  (∀ ⦃m n : ℕ⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < u n) →
      StrictMono u → ∑' (k : ℕ), f k ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (u 0), f k + ∑' (k : ℕ), (↑(u (k + 1)) - ↑(u k)) * f (u k)
